title: Resignation of Divisional Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable
author: MPSNet
excerpt: Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable, Divisional Sergeant Major of the Military Police School, has resigned after serving at MPS since April 2026.

body.text: The Divisional Sergeant Major of the Military Police School, Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable, has resigned from his position, closing a journey at MPS that began in April 2026.

AnthonyUnbeatable shared the news in a resignation notice addressed to the school, stating that he will step down from the position of Divisional Sergeant Major sometime this week. He had been thinking about the decision for a while and had wanted to resign weeks earlier.

In the notice, the Divisional Sergeant Major explained that holding a position in High Command had made it hard for him to keep his motivation, and that he is stepping aside so someone better can take his place. He also pointed to how busy his life has become, with school, work, sports, family and friends all demanding his time. He added that the resignation of Vice Chairman X_AgsFang played a part in his decision, and apologized to Commanding Officer MikeVicious for leaving him on his own.
Once you get to a higher position like HICOM, you lose motivation to do anything, so I am leaving so someone better can come.
body.by: Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable, Divisional Sergeant Major of MPS

body.text: AnthonyUnbeatable used the notice to thank everyone he had the opportunity to work alongside. He singled out combat for giving him an opportunity in MPS, and said he appreciated the experiences, opportunities, and friendships he gained along the way.

It's been a pleasure serving alongside you all, contributing to MPS, and watching the div grow. I've made a lot of memories here. But my time has come to resign. I wish MPS the best of luck in the future.
body.by: Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable, Divisional Sergeant Major of MPS

body.text: AnthonyUnbeatable joined the Military Police School on April 16, 2026. He rose through the Instructor ranks as Senior Staff Instructor, Lead Staff Instructor, Head Instructor and Chief Instructor, before becoming a member of High Command on October 6, 2026 as Divisional Sergeant Major.

Date | Rank | Position
--- | --- | ---
May 26, 2026 | Captain (O3) | Senior Staff Instructor
June 2, 2026 | Major (O4) | Lead Staff Instructor
June 15, 2026 | Lieutenant Colonel (O5) | Head Instructor
July 7, 2026 | Colonel (O6) | Chief Instructor
October 6, 2026 | Sergeant Major (E9B) | Divisional Sergeant Major
No successor has been announced. The position of Divisional Sergeant Major is currently listed as vacant, alongside the Executive Officer position.
MPSNet thanks Sergeant Major AnthonyUnbeatable for his service to the Military Police School and wishes him the best in everything that comes next.
